rows.b: Cinderella wakes up in a room filled with mirrors.
Her reflection appears on countless shimmering surfaces,
to the point where she's unable to tell which one is her true self.
As her sense of self gradually fades, Cinderella implores into the void.
- It's not important who you are. -
I want to become a goddess of victory.
I want to offer hope to mankind,
and be a comrade to the Goddesses.

- If you help the Goddesses,
then you will be one of them. -
What do I have to do to help the Goddesses?
- Slash and burn them, decimate them. -
- Then the Goddesses will be happy. -
Can you tell me who is the enemy of the Goddesses?
Aren't those who resemble me all comrades of the Goddesses?
- If you do not help them, they will be deceived -
- What a lamentable fate that would be, -
- for their noble journey may go unrewarded. -
- Very good. You are a most benevolent child. -
Cinderella is overcome with emotion, and tears begin to stream down her face.
